title: "Stop Saying ‘God Knows My Heart’ to Excuse Sin" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Stop Saying ‘God Knows My Heart’ to Excuse Sin" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God

🌍 [INTRODUCTION – URGENT WARNING]
⚠️ "God knows my heart!"

This is one of the most misused and dangerous phrases in Christianity today.
❌ Many say it to justify sin instead of repenting from it.
❌ Many use it as a free pass to disobey God.

🚨 Here’s the truth: Yes, God knows your heart… and that should TERRIFY you.
📖 "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?" (Jeremiah 17:9)
🔥 This is your wake-up call. You cannot fool God—He sees EVERYTHING.

🔥 [1. THE DANGEROUS LIE: "As Long as My Heart is Right, I Can Do What I Want"]
📖 "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death." (Proverbs 14:12)

💡 Many Christians today believe this lie:
🔴 "It doesn’t matter how I live, God knows my heart."
🔴 "I may sin, but God understands."
🔴 "I’m a good person, so I’ll be fine."

🚨 This is a trap from the enemy! The Bible says:
⚠️ Your heart is NOT naturally good—it is sinful and deceitful.
⚠️ God doesn’t judge by your intentions—He judges by your actions.
⚠️ Partial obedience is still disobedience.
📖 "For the Lord sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart." (1 Samuel 16:7)
🔥 If your heart is truly for God, it will show in the way you LIVE.

🔥 [2. THE EXCUSES PEOPLE USE TO JUSTIFY SIN]
Many people say "God knows my heart" to continue in sin without guilt.
Here are 4 of the most common excuses Christians use:

1️⃣ "I know it’s wrong, but God understands."
🚨 Truth: God calls you to REPENT, not make excuses.
📖 "Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out." (Acts 3:19)

2️⃣ "I’m not perfect, nobody is."
🚨 Truth: God doesn’t expect perfection, but He expects OBEDIENCE.
📖 "Be holy, for I am holy." (1 Peter 1:16)

3️⃣ "At least I’m not as bad as other people."
🚨 Truth: You are judged by GOD’S standard, not by comparing yourself to others.
📖 "Each of us will give an account of himself to God." (Romans 14:12)

4️⃣ "God knows I love Him, even if I sin."
🚨 Truth: If you love Him, you will OBEY Him.
📖 "If you love me, you will keep my commandments." (John 14:15)
🔥 Which of these excuses have you used? It’s time to stop justifying sin and start walking in true repentance!

🔥 [3. HOW TO TRULY HAVE A HEART FOR GOD]
🙌 A heart for God is shown by a LIFE that follows Him.

✅ 1. REPENT FROM SIN – Stop excusing it, turn away from it!
📖 "Let the wicked forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the Lord." (Isaiah 55:7)

✅ 2. SEEK GOD DAILY – Spend time in prayer and His Word.
📖 "Your word I have hidden in my heart, that I might not sin against You." (Psalm 119:11)

✅ 3. OBEY GOD COMPLETELY – Not just in words, but in actions.
📖 "But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves." (James 1:22)

✅ 4. ALLOW GOD TO CHANGE YOUR HEART – Ask Him to purify you.
📖 "Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me." (Psalm 51:10)
🔥 Today is the day to stop making excuses and fully surrender to Jesus!

🔥 THE REPENTANCE CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your life—what sins have you been excusing? Repent today.
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth!
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!
📖 "For God will bring every deed into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good or evil." (Ecclesiastes 12:14)

🧐 QUESTION FOR YOU:
Have you ever used "God knows my heart" to excuse sin?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 21, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I ask for Your mercy and forgiveness. Help me stop making excuses for sin and truly surrender to You. Cleanse my heart and lead me in Your righteousness. Give me the strength to walk in obedience and help others do the same. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
